svg.title: Free-Stuff-Near-You — Mint Tilt FSNY mark, v5
svg.desc: A gently tilted mint FSNY variant. Both point-and-hole motifs remain exact geometric twins and rotate together with the lettering in one composed identity. The right and bottom lobe segments are exact reflections across x equals y, with equal six-unit-radius openings at reflected positions. Original, unadopted concept with editable lettering.
